L13: ## NCAA Division II Transition
L14: 
L15: 【135†Image: NCAA Division II Transition】
L16: 
L17: A New Era for Falcon Athletics
L18: 
L19: Lackawanna College Athletics
L20: On June 26, 2025, Lackawanna College announced its intention to transition to NCAA Division II membership and join the Pennsylvania State Athletic Conference (PSAC). Beginning in 2026-27, Lackawanna College will begin competition in the Pennsylvania State Athletic Conference while continuing its NCAA Division II membership candidacy. This page serves as the official source for timeline updates, milestones, announcements, and key information regarding Lackawanna's transition to NCAA Division II athletics.
L21:  NCAA Division II Transition Anticipated Timeline
L22: ###
L23: 
L24: Year  | Milestone
L25: June 2025  | Accepted invitation to join PSAC
L26: 2025-26  | Final NJCAA season
L27: 2026-27  | Begin PSAC competition and expand athletic opportunities in support of Lackawanna College's four-year degree pathways.
L28: 2027-28  | NCAA Application Year 1
L29: 2028-29  | NCAA Application Year 2
L30: 2029-30 (Anticipated)  | Full NCAA Division II membership, pending successful completion of all NCAA membership requirements.
L31: 
L32: NCAA Membership Process
L33: Lackawanna College is currently working through the NCAA Division II membership process. This multi-year process includes:
L34: 
L35:   * Institutional self-study and strategic planning
L36:   * Compliance education and policy development
L37:   * Academic and athletics program enhancements
L38:   * Governance and operational requirements
L39:   * Student-athlete support initiatives
L40:   * NCAA membership benchmarks and reporting
L41: The College is committed to maintaining transparency throughout this process and will continue to provide updates as milestones are achieved.
L42: 
L43: The transition to NCAA Division II allows Lackawanna College to build upon its tradition of athletic excellence while expanding opportunities for future generations of student-athletes.

L84: # Paterson Field House Showcases Full Slate of Spring and Summer Opportunities for the Berkshires
L85: 
L86: PITTSFIELD, Mass. — Berkshire Community College (BCC) is inviting the community to get active, stay healthy, and take advantage of an exciting lineup of programs, facilities, and affordable memberships at 【46†Paterson Field House】 this spring and summer.
L87: Open to BCC students, faculty, staff, and the greater Berkshire community, Paterson Field House continues to serve as a regional hub for recreation, wellness, and connection — offering a wide range of opportunities for individuals and families of all ages.
L88: 
L89: The facility features a fully equipped fitness center, basketball court, turf field, tennis courts, and outdoor athletic spaces, along with a robust schedule of programs, events, and recreational activities designed to meet the needs of the community.
L90: 【65†Image: Paterson Field House swimming pool】【66†Image: BCC Falcon mascot in the Paterson gym†live.staticflickr.com】
L91: 
L92: Affordable and Accessible for All
L93: 
L94: Paterson Field House remains one of the most affordable fitness and recreation options in the Berkshires. Membership is free for BCC students and employees, while community memberships are offered at accessible rates, including monthly, seasonal, and annual options.
L95: Day passes are also available, making it easy for anyone to experience the facility without a long-term commitment.
L96: 
L97: > Paterson Field House is truly a resource for the entire Berkshire community. Whether you're a student looking to stay active, a family seeking affordable summer recreation, or a community member prioritizing wellness, this is a place where everyone can feel welcome, supported, and connected.
L98: >
L99: > Celia Norcross, BCC Dean of Students
L100: 
L101: Summer Highlights: Pool, Programs, and Outdoor Activity
L102: As summer approaches, one of Paterson's most anticipated features returns: its outdoor 【67†swimming pool】, set to reopen on June 20, 2026. The 25-yard pool, complete with lifeguards on duty and accessible amenities, offers an ideal space for recreation, exercise, and family fun.
L103: 
L104: With affordable daily rates and family-friendly pricing options, the pool provides an accessible way for Berkshire residents to stay active and cool throughout the summer months.
L105: “Summer at Paterson is something special,” said Daryl Shreve, Director of Recreational Services at the College. “From the pool to our outdoor spaces and programs, we're proud to offer a place where people of all ages can gather, stay active, and enjoy everything the Berkshires have to offer — without breaking the bank.”
L106: Additional summer offerings include swim clinics, recreational leagues, outdoor programming, and opportunities through BCC's Adventure Program, which connects participants to activities across the region.
L107: 
L108: Building Energy for BCC Athletics
L109: 
L110: Looking ahead to the fall, excitement is building around BCC's women's Volleyball program, which continues to grow as part of the College's return to intercollegiate athletics.

L201: ### Kraken Athletics
L202: Starting Fall 2026
L203: 
L204: The National Junior College Athletic Association (NJCAA) announced today Carteret Community College as a new member college joining the association, beginning in the 2026 -2027 academic year. Carteret Community College will look to sponsor women’s soccer, women’s cross country, and men’s baseball and will become postseason eligible in 2027- 2028.
L205: Dr. Tracy Mancini President of Carteret Community College stated, “We are thrilled to announce that Carteret Community College has been accepted into the NJCAA, marking a significant milestone in our commitment to student success and engagement. Competitive athletics will not only enrich campus and community life but also open new doors for students to pursue postsecondary education while continuing to compete in the sports they love.
L206: This is more than a win for our institution—it’s a win for every student who dreams of combining academic achievement with athletic excellence.”
